verdict.rationale: Baseten publishes source for Truss, its model-packaging and deployment tool, in a public GitHub repo (basetenlabs/truss), so part of the product's tooling is readable. The core hosted platform (Model APIs, MCM orchestration, training infrastructure) has no evidence of public source, and the evidence pack never names an open license for Truss. Missing for 10: an explicitly named open-source license, public source for the core platform and inference stack, and independent corroboration of the openness.
